description: PROVIDER: set who can rent a node, replacing the whole list. Each entry is {kind: "email", value: "ana@company.com"}, {kind: "domain", value: "company.com"} or {kind: "org", value: "<organization name or ID>"}. A non-empty list makes the node PRIVATE: only those renters see it and can rent it, and ParalonCloud places no inference or other work on it, so it earns from their rentals only. [] opens it to everyone again. Call get_node_access first to keep existing entries. Always confirm with the user first. People and organizations added are told by email.
name: set_node_access
